entities.summary: Idun Reiten was a Norwegian professor of mathematics. She was considered to be one of Norway's greatest mathematicians during her lifetime. With national and international honors and recognition, she had supervised 11 students and had 28 academic descendants as of March 2024. She was an expert in representation theory, and is known for work in tilting theory and Artin algebras.
